newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom, Telecel surge in Lisbon.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom, Telecel surge in Lisbon.

text.p: Portugal Telecom (PT) gained 5.34 percent on Monday to 5,250 escudos ($33.2), smashing through resistance at 5,200 escudos, and traders said it was difficult to put an upper limit to the advance.
Mobile phone group Telecel was up 4.3 percent at 12,100 escudos having broken resistance at 12,000 as the overall market rose over two percent on the PSI20 index.
"PT and Telecel are in fashion and they are also companies with a good track record and good perspectives," said one trader.
"Put limits to the (price) advances, say where they could reach, is difficult, because they have already broken through past ceilings," added another trader.
